products.name: QIDI PLA Rapido
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 200-240 C, bed 35-55 C (with glue), speed 20-300 mm/s, density 1.22, drying 50-55 C 6-8 h, Tg 60 C, Vicat 73 C, HDT 59 C. Comparison guide: bed 45-60 C textured PEI / 30-45 C Cool Plate, fan 50-100 %, drying 50-55 C 4-6 h, 0.2-0.8 mm any nozzle material, closed chamber not required. Older wiki table: density 1.24, nozzle 200-230 C, bed 60 C, fan 100 %. Page says 'Closed chamber not recommend'. 1.75 +/-0.03 mm.

products.name: QIDI PLA Matte Rapido
products.notes: Comparison guide: nozzle 210-230 C, bed 45-60 C textured PEI (30-45 C Cool Plate), speed 40-80 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 50-55 C 4-6 h, any nozzle material. Density 1.42 from older wiki table (the matte filler makes it denser). Older wiki table recommended a hardened-steel nozzle for this product; the current guide lists 'All Material'. Page: 'Closed chamber not recommend'. Fan_pct is upper end of 50-100 %. drying_temp_c is upper end of range.

products.name: QIDI PLA Basic
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 190-240 C, bed 30-60 C (with glue), speed 20-300 mm/s, density 1.17, drying 50-55 C 6-8 h, Vicat 61.6 C, HDT 57.6 C. Comparison guide lists a narrower 210-230 C / 50-60 C bed / 30-50 mm/s / fan 50-100 % / drying 50 C 4-8 h. Support filament: PETG Basic. Brass/copper 0.4/0.6 nozzles listed.

products.name: QIDI PLA Matte Basic
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 190-240 C, bed 30-60 C (with glue), speed 20-300 mm/s, density 1.32, drying 50-55 C 6-8 h, Vicat 62.8 C, HDT 57 C. Comparison guide: 210-230 C, bed 50-60 C, 30-50 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 50-60 C 4-6 h. Easy support removal; support filament PETG Basic.

products.name: QIDI PLA Rapido Silk
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 210-230 C, bed 60 C (with glue), speed 40-200 mm/s, density 1.24, drying 50 C 4-6 h, Vicat 60 C, HDT 53 C, melt 160 C. Comparison guide: bed 45-60 C, speed 40-80 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 45-50 C 4-6 h. Store title is 'PLA Silk Filament'. Lower speeds recommended; avoid large overhangs; closed chamber not recommended.

products.name: QIDI PLA Rapido Metal
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 190-220 C, bed 60 C (with glue), speed 40-200 mm/s, density 1.19-1.21 (1.20 used), drying 50 C 4-6 h, Vicat 62 C, HDT 58 C, melt 160 C. Comparison guide ('PLA Metal'): bed 45-60 C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 45-50 C 4-6 h. More viscous than regular PLA, print slower.

products.name: QIDI PLA Wood
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 190-220 C, bed 30-60 C (with glue), speed 40-200 mm/s, density 1.22-1.24 (1.23 used), drying 50 C 4-6 h (alt. 55+/-5 C 8 h), Vicat 58 C, HDT 57 C. Comparison guide: 0.4-0.8 mm any material, bed 45-60 C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 50-55 C 4-6 h, keep sealed with desiccant. Wood powder is mildly abrasive and clogs small nozzles; QIDI lists all nozzle materials, so abrasive=false. Page lists hardened steel first in hotend compatibility. Variants out of stock at retrieval.

products.name: QIDI PLA-CF
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 210-240 C, bed 40-60 C, speed <=200 mm/s, fan 80-100 %, drying 50 C 4-6 h, retraction 1-3 mm @1800-3600 mm/min, nozzle >=0.4 mm, 'Phaetus hardened steel and above grade nozzles shall be selected'. Density 1.25 from older wiki table (not on page). Comparison guide: 100-200 mm/s, fan 0-50 % (conflicts with page 80-100 %), bed 45-60 C, drying 50 C 4-6 h.

products.name: QIDI PETG Basic
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 240-280 C, bed 70-80 C, speed 20-250 mm/s, density 1.26, drying 60-65 C 6-8 h, Vicat 79.7 C, HDT 71.8 C. Comparison guide: 240-260 C, bed 70-80 C PEI / 60-80 C Cool Plate, 30-50 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 60-65 C 4-6 h. Fan_pct is the upper end of 0-50 %.

products.name: QIDI PETG Translucent
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 240-280 C, bed 70-80 C, speed 20-250 mm/s, density 1.26, drying 55-65 C 4-6 h (>=8 h recommended for transparency), Vicat 79.7 C, HDT 71.8 C. Page tip: 'Turn off all fans during printing' and print hot for clarity; comparison guide allows 0-50 %. fan_pct=0 per page tip.

products.name: QIDI PETG Rapido
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 240-275 C, bed 70-80 C, speed 20-320 mm/s (marketing: 300 mm/s), density 1.31, drying 60-65 C 5-8 h, Vicat 83 C, HDT 70 C. Comparison guide: 235-275 C, <=300 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 60-65 C 4-6 h.

products.name: QIDI PETG-Tough
products.notes: Comparison guide: nozzle 230-260 C, bed 70-80 C textured PEI, 30-300 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 60-65 C 6-8 h, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, keep sealed with desiccant. Older wiki table: 240-270 C, bed 80 C, 20-180 mm/s, fan 60 %, drying 50 C 4-6 h, density 1.24, HDT 78 C. Product page has no numeric specs (images only). 1.75 +/-0.02 mm.

products.name: QIDI PETG-CF
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 240-270 C, bed 70-80 C, speed 20-150 mm/s, density 1.31, drying 65 C 5-8 h, Vicat 83 C, HDT 77 C; 'A hardened steel nozzle or harder is recommended'. Comparison guide: 40-150 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70 C 4-6 h, hardened steel 0.4-0.8 mm, annealing optional 80-90 C 2-4 h.

products.name: QIDI PETG-GF
products.notes: Material enum has no PETG-GF; recorded as PETG with glass-fiber variant. Product page: nozzle 240-270 C, bed 70-80 C, speed 20-120 mm/s, density 1.26, drying 65 C 5-8 h, Vicat 85 C, HDT 76 C; hardened steel nozzle or harder recommended; electrically insulating. Comparison guide: 250-275 C, <=150 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70 C 4-6 h, hardened 0.4-0.8 mm.

products.name: QIDI ABS Rapido
products.notes: Comparison guide: nozzle 220-250 C, bed 90-110 C textured PEI, 40-80 mm/s, fan 0-80 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required. Product page: 'Enclosure Printers Required', 'Active chamber heating recommended' (no number). Chamber 50 C and density 1.05 from older wiki table, which listed nozzle 250-280 C, bed 100 C, fan 30 %, drying 60 C 4-6 h, annealing 80-90 C 6-12 h. Nozzle range conflicts between sources. TDS PDF in QIDI Drive folder.

products.name: QIDI Odorless-ABS Rapido
products.notes: Product page: bed 100-110 C PEI, speed 80-300 mm/s, fan 0-60 %, nozzle >=0.2 mm, retraction 1-5 mm, enclosed printer required, 'Active chamber heating recommended, 55-80 C if the printer has a heated chamber' (55 recorded as minimum), drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, support: S-White. Nozzle 240-260 C from comparison guide (page gives none). Density 1.05 and HDT 92 C from older wiki table (which grouped it with ABS Rapido at 250-280 C, chamber 50 C).

products.name: QIDI ABS Rapido Metal
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 220-250 C, bed 80-100 C (with glue), speed 40-200 mm/s, density 1.05-1.07 (1.06 used), drying 60 C 4-6 h, Vicat 91 C, HDT 75 C, melt 190 C; reduce cooling fan to avoid cracks/uneven gloss. Comparison guide: bed 90-110 C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, closed chamber required. Chamber 45 C from older wiki table ('ABS-Metal').

products.name: QIDI ABS-GF25
products.notes: Comparison guide: nozzle 250-270 C, bed 90-110 C textured PEI, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h (required), hardened steel 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 87 C. 0.5 kg page: 250-270 C, 40-200 mm/s. Density 1.15, chamber 45 C, bed 100 C, fan 20 % from older wiki table. Sold as 1 kg (qidi-tech-abs-gf25-filament) and 0.5 kg (qidi-tech-abs-gf25-0-5kg-filament) spools.

products.name: QIDI ASA
products.notes: Product page parameter image: nozzle 240-280 C, bed 100-110 C, fan 0-60 %, 1.75 +/-0.02 mm. Comparison guide: 240-260 C, bed 80-110 C, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 93 C. Older wiki table: 260-280 C, bed 100-110 C, chamber 50 C, density 1.07, annealing 80-90 C 6-12 h. Chamber and density from older wiki table.

products.name: QIDI ASA-Aero
products.notes: Product page: bed 80-110 C PEI, speed 30-90 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, nozzle >=0.4 mm (0.6 mm+ for thin walls), retraction OFF, raft gap 0.18-0.2 mm, max foaming ratio 250 %, keep enclosed printer in ventilated area, ambient 40-70 C during printing helps reduce warping (not a chamber setpoint). Nozzle 240-280 C and drying 70-80 C 6-8 h from comparison guide (closed chamber required, HDT 70 C). Density not published (foamed, temperature dependent). Store feed shipping weight 1300 g; assumed 1 kg net (unconfirmed). Annealing not recommended.

products.name: QIDI ASA-CF20 Core
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 250-280 C, bed 90-100 C, speed 30-250 mm/s, density 1.06, drying 60-70 C 4-6 h, HDT 95.8 C (1.8 MPa) / 101.1 C (0.45 MPa); 'Use Phaetus Hardened Steel or higher-grade' nozzles; support: S-White. Comparison guide: bed 90-110 C, fan 0-50 %, drying 80 C 4-6 h (required), closed chamber required, seal with desiccant.

products.name: QIDI PC/ABS-FR
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 260-280 C, bed 70-80 C (with PVP glue/3D LAC), chamber 60-80 C (70 recorded as midpoint; range 60-80), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.08, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, HDT 102 C, melt 250 C. Comparison guide and older wiki disagree: 240-270 C, bed 100-110 C (PEI or PC plate), 30-300 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 80 C 4-6 h, chamber 50-65 C (older wiki), fan 20 % (older wiki). Out of stock at retrieval.

products.name: QIDI PA12-CF
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 280-300 C, bed 40-70 C (with PVP glue), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.09, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 78.4 C (annealed 149.6/112.4 C per older wiki), melt 167 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-6 h. Comparison guide: fan 0-50 %, hardened steel 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, annealing 100 C 8 h. Older wiki table: fan 15 %, drying 100-120 C 4-6 h. No chamber temperature published. Support: S-White.

products.name: QIDI PAHT-CF (PPA-CF)
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 300-320 C, bed 70-90 C (with glue), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.20, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 84.8 C unannealed / 190.7 C annealed, melt 237 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-6 h. QIDI blog/TDS: part cooling fan OFF (guide allows 0-50 %), retraction 1-3 mm @1800-3600 mm/min, 0.2 mm bimetal nozzle not recommended; QIDI BOX / PTFE multi-material feeding not recommended for this filament. Enclosure required; no chamber temperature published. Wiki engineering tips: dry 80 C >=8 h, anneal ~80 C 8 h.

products.name: QIDI PAHT-GF (PPA-GF)
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 300-320 C, bed 70-90 C (with glue), speed 30-160 mm/s, density 1.27, drying 80-100 C 4-8 h, HDT 80 C (unannealed; 180 C in guide after annealing), melt 237 C, water absorption 1.75 %, annealing 80-100 C 4-8 h, heater block >=12 mm recommended. Comparison guide: 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, hardened 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, annealing 100 C 8 h. Support: S-White.

products.name: QIDI UltraPA Nylon (PPA)
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 260-280 C, bed 70-80 C (with PVP glue), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.21, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 72.5 C, melt 231 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-6 h. Comparison guide: fan 0-50 %, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 79.6 C. Older wiki table listed 280-320 C, bed 80 C, hardened steel, fan 20 %.

products.name: QIDI UltraPA-CF25 (PPA-CF25)
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 300-340 C, bed 70-80 C (with glue), speed 30-200 mm/s, density 1.23, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 196.9 C, melt 237 C. Comparison guide: 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, hardened 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, annealing 100 C 8 h. Older wiki: fan 20 %, annealing 80-100 C 6-8 h. Store variant label '1000g'.

products.name: QIDI PET-CF (PET-CF17)
products.notes: Product page (current TDS 'PET-CF17'): nozzle 270-300 C, bed 70-80 C (glue), speed up to 300 mm/s, density 1.34, drying 100 C 10 h, annealing 80-100 C 4-8 h (TDS: 120 C 10 h). QIDI blog: TDS chamber = room temperature, print enclosed with heater off, fan off (guide allows 0-50 %); earlier product page listed 280-320 C / 80 C / 40-200 mm/s / drying 100 C 4-8 h. Comparison guide: closed chamber required, HDT 155.3 C. Cardboard spool: use a spool adapter in QIDI BOX. Support: S-White.

products.name: QIDI PET-GF
products.notes: Material enum has no PET-GF; recorded under PET-CF with glass-fiber variant. Product page: nozzle 260-320 C, bed 80 C (with glue), speed 30-200 mm/s, density 1.38, drying 100-120 C 4-8 h, Vicat 148.8 C, HDT 86.7 C (120.3 C annealed per guide), melt 251 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-8 h, heater block >=12 mm. Comparison guide: 280-320 C, bed 60-80 C, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, hardened 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required.

products.name: QIDI PPS-CF
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 310-350 C, bed 100 C (with glue), speed 30-100 mm/s, density 1.3, drying 100-140 C 8-12 h (do not exceed 160 C), humidity <20 % RH, Vicat 268 C, HDT 242.7 C, melt 284 C. QIDI blog: bed 100-110 C, chamber actively heated 60-65 C (65 recorded), fan 0-30 %, annealing 120 C >=6 h; comparison guide: 30-60 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 100 C 10 h, annealing 130 C 10 h. 750 g spool (store variant), cardboard spool.

products.name: QIDI PPS-GF20
products.notes: Material enum has no PPS-GF; recorded under PPS-CF with glass-fiber variant. Product page: nozzle 300-350 C (equipment must reach 310-350 C; 310 used as min), bed 80-100 C, speed 20-150 mm/s, density 1.36, drying 100 C 8-10 h, Vicat 272.5 C, HDT 236.3 C, annealing 130 C 10 h; hardened steel or better nozzle. Comparison guide: bed 80-90 C, up to 250 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, closed chamber required. No chamber temperature published (PPS-CF guidance of 60-65 C likely applies). 750 g cardboard spool; use spool adapter in QIDI BOX.

products.name: QIDI S-White Support
products.notes: Support filament for PA12-CF, PAHT-CF/GF, PET-CF, ASA-CF20 etc. Product page: extruder 280-300 C, bed 40-80 C (PEI or PVP glue), fan OFF, 1 kg. Comparison guide: 260-280 C (260-300 overall), bed 60-80 C with PVP glue, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h (required), any nozzle, closed chamber required, seal with desiccant. Density 1.23 from older wiki table. Nozzle range recorded from the current comparison guide; page says 280-300 C.

products.name: QIDI TPU95A-HF
products.notes: Product page parameter image: nozzle 210-230 C, bed RT-50 C, speed 30-120 mm/s, 95A, 1.75 +/-0.02 mm. Comparison guide: bed 35-50 C, fan 50-100 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h (required), any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, no enclosure. Older wiki table: drying 50 C 4-6 h, fan 100 %, density 1.15. Density from older wiki table. QIDI Slicer ships a TPU95A profile. Not QIDI BOX compatible.

products.name: QIDI TPU-Aero
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 230-270 C, bed 30-45 C (with glue), speed 30-50 mm/s, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, Vicat 70.4 C; hardness adjustable 85A to 65A via temperature/flow (e.g. 250 C, flow 0.68); page lists 'Density 0.74 g/cm3' which is the foamed printed part. Raw filament density 1.15 taken from older wiki table. Comparison guide: <100 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying required, no enclosure, annealing not recommended. Direct-drive only; disable retraction tuning expectations (stringing inherent). Not QIDI BOX compatible.

products.name: QIDI TPU-GF
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 240-270 C, bed 35-60 C, speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.32, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, 67 Shore D, Vicat 157.3 C, Charpy non-break, Z tear strength 63.21 kN/m; direct-drive extruder recommended; hardened steel nozzle listed first. Comparison guide: hardened steel 0.4-0.8 mm, fan 50-100 %, drying 60 C 4-6 h (required), bed 35-50 C, no enclosure.

products.name: QIDI PEBA 95A
products.notes: Product page: nozzle 230-260 C, bed 35-75 C, speed 20-120 mm/s, density 1.01, drying 70-75 C 4-6 h (page text also says 6-8 h), Vicat 102.8 C; >12 % lighter than TPU 95A; TDS specimens printed 240 C / bed 100 C / 60 mm/s. Comparison guide: bed 60-100 C, 30-120 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 60 C 4-6 h, any nozzle, no enclosure, annealing not recommended. 800 g spool. Not QIDI BOX compatible.
